command: claude --permission-mode auto (interactive TUI, driven under a pty), prompted to dispatch a Task subagent
note: The CHILD's own transcript, which is where `attributionAgent` lives — the parent's had zero. Its hooks are deliberately NOT shipped here: CC's hook transcript_path always points at the PARENT, so hooks and this transcript key to different sessions and could not share a one-AgentId scenario. Home path redacted to /Users/dev. Redacted: the recorder's own MCP server / skill inventory (tool NAMES only, no credentials) to generic placeholders — a public repo and an immutable crates.io tarball are the wrong home for one machine's tooling roster, and no decoder reads those fields.
